ui.title: Supplier Disruption Impact Analyst
ui.tagline: When a supplier or site goes down, walks the supply graph to every part, product and customer order that depends on it, checks stock cover in parallel, quantifies days short and revenue at risk, and raises the mitigation a planner approves.
